newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed narrowly mixed on Monday in moderate trade on some late local buying and selling interest, dealers said.
"The morning session was quiet and featureless on lack of fresh factors. The ring sessions were silent, there were no Chinese enquiries and the big boys were nowhere to be seen," a local broker said.
"But the market turned mixed in the afternoon on some late local buying and selling amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. Volume was moderate," the broker said.
"Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly as the yen's weakness against the U.S. dollar led to moderate shortcovering, but had little impact on prices here," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, August RSS3 rose two cents to 110.00 U.S. cents a kg.
August RSS1 rose half a cent to 153.50 Singapore cents (US$1.08) a kg.
July TSR20 fell 3.75 cents to 140.75 Singapore cents (US$0.99) a kg.
